changes.comment: sdk-model, sdk-backend-spi: Added @alpha workspace brand kit for reports (IReportsBrandKit: colors, typography incl. hosted font faces, externally hosted assets) with sanitizeReportsBrandKit for its free-form stored content, brand-kit read/write on IWorkspaceReportsService (getBrandKit/setBrandKit/deleteBrandKit; tiger persists to localStorage until the reportsBrandKit setting is available), and the logoInverse built-in report variable plus reserved image_ variables resolving brand kit images.
